id./param/scenario/cs/b_030_cs_110.pack|cs_: "The move Robert just used is the temple's ultimate secret, Pearly Gates.
"It was devised in the Age of Heroes by Morcant, one of Erdwin's companions.
"And the move I'll teach you is no less great: Quadraslash.
"Quadraslash is a peerless secret that Erdwin devised in training with our first Grand Master, Ai Yi.
"I see. With me knowing Morcant's move and you Erdwin's, we'll be unstoppable.
"But though passed down in the temple, no one but Erdwin ever mastered Quadraslash.
"You'll learn it in no time at all, so the training will be absurdly harsh.
"{var:1}, are you ready to endure any hardship that awaits?
"Hm. Spineless like your grandfather. Looks like I need one smack...
"Fool! You say that only because you don't know the Naughty Stick's power!
"Disobey the Grand Master and your bottom will swell red! Reconsider, I beg you!
"Quadraslash turns your own magic into a blade. Hold out your hand, imagine a sword, and focus your magic.
"Well, that's about right for a first try. The rest you'll polish in real battle.
"Surely not with the Grand Master... No, that's too soon...
"Huh? What are you saying? {var:1}'s opponent is you. You. Y-O-U.
"You just learned the secret. You're the perfect opponent.
"A fight between two of Dundrasil's royal blood. This'll be a show. Tell me when you're ready."
